column1: # Rename contract (decided 2026-10-12), applied to the docs and the code on 2026-10-12. check-repo.sh proves it over
# scope.txt; unchanged.md lists what keeps upstream's spelling. Column 1 is a Perl regex, column 2 the replacement.
# Order matters: longer and more specific patterns first.
# The host is also the WeKnoraCloud model API (bare host and /api paths), which stays; only website links move.
# --- directories, containers, network, desktop app name (before the product-name rule) ---
# --- helm chart and release name, local image, in-image path ---
# --- product name in prose (identifiers above are matched first) ---
# --- embed widget JS global and webhook User-Agent (before the product-name rule) ---
# --- lowercase identifiers (decided 2026-10-12: everything). Hyphenated slugs -> ai-kb, single tokens, snake_case,
# camelCase and dotted keys -> aikb (a Postgres GUC cannot hold a hyphen), database names -> ai_kb.
# WeKnoraCloud (Tencent's hosted model API) and BrowserSkill release artifacts keep upstream's name.
# Identifiers (Go, TS, storage keys, globals); CJK counts as \w in Perl, so prose rows use ASCII boundaries.
